name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Trump announces $180 million to boost mining education
changes.summary: President Trump announced over $180 million in grants to boost educational programs for the mining industry, part of a bid to increase critical mineral production.

changes.title: Bill Cassidy Will Back Todd Blanche as Attorney General, Salvaging His Confirmation
changes.summary: The Louisiana senator said that, despite reservations, he would back President Trump’s pick for attorney general, giving Republicans enough votes for a majority.

changes.title: Trump Signs Executive Orders Targeting Birthright Citizenship and ‘Birth Tourism’
changes.summary: The orders come after the Supreme Court ruled June 30 that President Trump’s previous efforts to end birthright citizenship were unconstitutional.

changes.title: Morning news brief
changes.summary: Trump issues new orders to limit birthright citizenship, Iran shares details of an agreement with Oman to reopen Strait of Hormuz, Trump under pressure to find a breakthrough with Iran.

changes.title: Trump's firings of federal officials set stage for next presidential power test
changes.summary: A federal appeals court is set to consider President Trump's effort to fire two immigration judges this fall, a case that could have significant implications for federal workers.

changes.title: Sen. Cassidy says he'll vote to confirm Todd Blanche for attorney general
changes.summary: Republican Sen. Bill Cassidy said Friday he will back Todd Blanche's nomination as attorney general, likely paving the way for Blanche to be confirmed to lead President Donald Trump's Justice Department.

changes.title: A deal with Iran over the Strait of Hormuz may require a compromise from Trump
changes.summary: To reach a deal with Iran that reopens the economically vital Strait of Hormuz, President Donald Trump may need to do something out of character — compromise.

changes.title: 'I'm very good at grass.' Why Trump goes into the weeds on one of his favorite topics
changes.summary: President Donald Trump loves talking about grass, even in settings where such a topic might seem out of place. Since returning to the White House early last year, the Republican has spoken about grass at least 45 times in public events or interviews.

changes.title: Iranians Say Trump’s Promises Have Fallen by the Wayside as Iran War Drags On
changes.summary: As President Trump struggles to extricate the United States from the war in Iran, his promises to protesters in the country have fallen by the wayside.

changes.title: Trump mounts new effort to fire Fed's Lisa Cook after Supreme Court ruling
changes.summary: The White House has informed Lisa Cook, a member of the Federal Reserve Board of Governors, that President Trump is considering firing her.
